description.value: Gateway Pizza is a long-running Surrey restaurant that merges Canadian-style pizza with an extensive Indian curry menu, including biryanis, butter chicken, and paneer dishes. The Surrey Centre location is one of two family-owned outlets serving the broader Surrey area and offers takeout alongside delivery. Cyclists passing through the Guildford corridor would find a wide range of filling options, including a substantial vegetarian selection.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Surrey Centre/Surrey Guildford location of Gateway Pizza at 9183 148 Street, matching the OSM address; the site provides phone 604-589-3333 for this location, which is absent from OSM. Takeout is confirmed by the website's explicit takeout delivery charge references, and vegetarian options are confirmed by the dedicated vegetarian menu section and 'Veggie toppings' pricing note. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM name 'Gate-Way Pizza' contains a hyphen not present on the website's consistent 'Gateway Pizza' branding.
concerns: OSM name 'Gate-Way Pizza' does not match website branding 'Gateway Pizza' (no hyphen) — the hyphenated form appears to be an OSM data-entry artefact.
Phone number is absent from OSM; 604-589-3333 sourced solely from website contact page for the Surrey Centre location.
OSM source is 2010 City of Surrey GIS data; the record may not have been manually reviewed since then, though the website appears active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, actively operating pizza and Indian food restaurant with confirmed takeout and vegetarian options, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists two locations under the same brand: Newton Head Office at Suite 101-12877 76 Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 1E6 (tel 604-590-3333), and Surrey Centre at 9183 148 Street, Surrey, BC V3R 3W7 (tel 604-589-3333). This OSM record corresponds to the Surrey Centre location only.

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly references takeout: '$6 will be charged for delivery on any take out' and home page tagline 'Don't Cook tonight, Just Call US Now'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section (Paneer Tikka Masala, Tawa Paneer, Handi Paneer, Channa Masala, etc.) and website distinguishes 'Veggie toppings' from 'Non-veggie toppings' for pizza; no GF or vegan claims confirmed

wow_evidence: one of two family-owned outlets serving the broader Surrey area
